map.📖 查看「阳台光照时长估算使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Balcony Sunlight Duration Estimation Usage Guide"
map.你家阳台适合养什么花？输入朝向、楼层与季节，估算每日直射光照时长，推荐适宜植物与: Which flowers suit your balcony? Enter the orientation, floor and season to estimate daily direct sunlight hours and get recommended suitable plants with care tips.
map.按朝向（南/东/西/北）、楼层（低层易受遮挡、高层更通透）与季节查经验基准表，再: Look up an empirical baseline table by orientation (south/east/west/north), floor (low floors are more obstructed, high floors more open) and season, then apply the floor correction: a south-facing mid floor gets about 8h in summer and 4h in winter; a north-facing balcony is mostly diffuse light with under 2h direct sun.
map.南向 6 楼、夏季：估算每日直射约 8h → 适合月季、茉莉、番茄等喜阳植物；同: South-facing 6th floor in summer: about 8h direct light daily → suits sun-loving plants such as roses, jasmine and tomatoes; in winter under the same conditions about 4h, so switch to short-day flowers such as kalanchoe and succulents; a north-facing balcony can only grow shade-tolerant plants such as ferns and hostas. West-facing low floor in summer: baseline 6h − 1h obstruction = 5h, classified as half sun.
map.北向冬季为什么是 0 小时？: Why does a north-facing balcony show 0 hours in winter?
map.北半球朝北的阳台冬季几乎全天处于建筑阴影，只有散射光，模型按 0 小时直射计；若: In the northern hemisphere a north-facing balcony stays in building shadow almost all winter and receives only diffuse light, so the model counts 0 direct hours; if the building spacing is large or there is side reflection, add 0.5-1h.
map.结果能精确到小时吗？: Are the results accurate to the hour?
map.不能。基准表是经验值，楼层只按低/中/高做 ±1 小时修正，未考虑楼间距、窗外树: No. The baseline is empirical, and the floor correction is only ±1h by low/mid/high; building spacing, trees outside the window, awnings and city latitude are not modelled. Use the result to guide plant selection; measure actual light with a lux meter.

map.西向夏季午后强光高温，宜选耐晒品种（太阳花、仙人掌）或加遮阳网，避免娇嫩叶菜灼伤: A west-facing balcony gets strong light and high temperature in the afternoon in summer, so choose sun-tolerant varieties (portulaca, cactus) or add shade netting to avoid scorching tender leafy vegetables.
map.光照不足如何补？: How do I compensate for insufficient light?
map.可补植物补光灯（全光谱 LED，每日 12-16h），或改用耐阴品种，减少开花类: Add a plant grow light (full spectrum LED, 12-16h daily), or switch to shade-tolerant varieties and reduce the proportion of flowering plants.
